body:
Follow-up to `simdesign-meshmargin` (track 5). Compares peak and patch-averaged von Mises stress on four L-bracket designs over five meshes. Peak rises 18–41%; a 3 mm patch average moves 1–6% but reads 0.45–0.69 of the peak, so it needs its own limit. Stylised, 2D, assumed values. 5 tests pass; `python site/build.py` prints ok.
